before: Access to resources and support groups is vital for women managing lymphedema. These groups offer a safe space to share experiences, learn coping strategies, and gain emotional support from others who understand what they are going through. Organizations dedicated to breast cancer and lymphedema often provide valuable information, educational materials, and practical advice on how to treat lymphedema and prevent lymphedema. The lymphatic system benefits from patients gaining access to resources and support.

For a Singapore peer-support resource, see the Lymphatics Association of Singapore.
